thread:
maria (CSM): Quick ask  Were putting together a tiny 'Launch Readiness Shortlist' for customers hitting livemode. Short, prescriptive, and attachable to onboarding emails. Focus areas: prefill, cache hygiene, batching, streaming fallbacks, and a clear renewal-risk signal.

lee (Solutions Eng): Love the idea. Keep it to one page + a 2-line email they can paste. Add a small client-side retry/backoff check.

ashley (Field Ops): Make the ops steps copy-paste runnable. Customers like one-liners they can run from CLI.

maria (CSM): Agreed. Drafting now. My proposed layout: 1) Quick preflight, 2) Prefill example, 3) Cache invalidation snippet, 4) Batching knobs, 5) Streaming + fallback, 6) What to send Support, 7) Renewal-risk triggers.

noah (Support): Please include exact telemetry we need up-front so we don't ask for follow-ups. Also, an example 'urgent triage' message they can drop into our portal helps speed up response time.

ops-bot: note: template created -> cs/launch-readiness-shortlist (draft)

maria (CSM): Draft content (keep edits short):

-- Preflight checks --
- Confirm route pinned to expected model version.
- Record a short baseline: 50 sample requests -> median latency and p95. Save as baseline.json.

-- Prefill (one-line) --
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/cache/prefill" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"tenant_id":"ACME-123","prompts":["greeting","invoice-summary"],"ttl_seconds":43200}'

Note: Prefill reduces cold-start tails but is not a hard guarantee for KV residency on every GPU.

-- Cache invalidation (quick) --
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/cache/invalidate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"tenant_id":"ACME-123","keys":["kv:user:42"]}'

-- Batching recommendations --
- If interactive chat UI: target_batch_size=12-20, max_wait_ms=10-25.
- If server-side bulk scoring: target_batch_size=64-128, max_wait_ms=50-120.
Example config snippet: `batch { target_size: 16 max_wait_ms: 20 }`
Tradeoff: higher batches -> lower token cost but higher median latency for single messages.

-- Streaming + fallback --
- Recommend `stream=true` for UXs that can incrementally render. Ensure client handles partial chunks and reconnects.
- Fallback pattern: set `fallback_model: redwood-lite` or `route:fallback` when observed latency exceeds SLO or tokens consumed spikes.

-- KV prefixing pointer --
For multi-tenant prompts, prefix keys with a tenant-scoped string to avoid cache pollution. Example: `kv_prefix = sha256(tenant_id)[:10]`.

-- What to send Support (copy-paste list) --
Please include: 1) request_id(s) 2) route + model version 3) sample prompt (redacted) 4) client/server timestamps 5) streaming error payload (if any) 6) last deploy sha.

-- Urgent triage template (paste into portal) --
"Urgent: live latency spike. Request IDs: [id1,id2]. Observed median latency 2x baseline since 2026-03-18 14:00 UTC. Attached baseline.json + recent traces. Please triage and advise fallback enablement"

-- Renewal-risk triggers (automated) --
Flag AE + SE when ANY of:
- >= 2 production incidents in 7 days
- sustained median latency >= 2x baseline for 48+ hours
- customer-reported severe UX regressions (NPS drop > 10 points)
Process: 15-min AE+SE sync, then 24-hour mitigation plan and weekly health pulse until stable.

lee (Solutions Eng): Add a small retry/backoff validation: ensure client does exponential backoff with jitter and caps at 5 retries. Example header check: `Retry-After` honored, `x-client-retries` not > 5.

ashley (Field Ops): Suggest a short email subject and body:
Subject: "Quick checklist before you hit production"
Body: "Hi <Name> \nAttached is a 1-page checklist to reduce cold tails and speed triage if anything arises. Run the prefill command, confirm batching settings, and save baseline.json. If you hit an issue, paste the urgent triage template into support."

noah (Support): I'll add the 'Info request' and 'Escalation' snippets to our KB and link it from the one-pager. Also: include a note to redact PII in prompts before sharing.

maria (CSM): Perfect. Ill polish wording, create the one-pager PDF, and make the email snippet available in the onboarding folder. Target: share with CS leads in tomorrow's sync. Thanks team! :rocket:
